brief: The AI research workflow that saves 10 hours per week. The exact tools, prompts, and rituals.

slots.subtitle: A step‑by‑step workflow that trims ten hours from your weekly research grind.
slots.preview1: How a nightly prompt batch saves hours
slots.preview2: The toolchain that never misses a citation
slots.preview3: Rituals that turn chaos into clarity

slots.title: Map the process
slots.subtitle: Start by diagramming every research touchpoint from idea to paper.
slots.insight1Body: Break work into ideation, sourcing, drafting, and validation phases.
slots.insight2Body: Limit each stage to a fixed block, forcing focus and speed.
slots.insight3Body: Use scripts to move outputs between tools without manual copy‑paste.
slots.pullQuote: A clear map turns vague effort into measurable sprint.

slots.title: Choose your arsenal
slots.subtitle: Combine AI assistants, reference managers, and automation hubs for a seamless pipeline.
slots.insight1Body: Prompt the model to summarize papers into bullet points in seconds.
slots.insight2Body: Tag and sync sources automatically, avoiding manual bibliography work.
slots.insight3Body: Trigger actions like saving summaries to Notion whenever a new prompt finishes.
slots.pullQuote: When tools talk, you stop typing.

slots.title: Build reusable prompts
slots.subtitle: Create a small set of templates that cover the most common research tasks.
slots.insight1Body: Prompt: ‘List 5 novel angles for X topic in 30 seconds.’
slots.insight2Body: Prompt: ‘Extract all DOI links from this PDF.’
slots.insight3Body: Prompt: ‘Create a structured outline for a 2000‑word paper on Y.’
slots.pullQuote: A prompt is a reusable research shortcut.

slots.title: Start with a scan
slots.subtitle: Spend 15 minutes reviewing AI‑generated alerts and updating your prompt queue.
slots.insight1Body: Use Feedly + AI to surface new papers relevant to your topics.
slots.insight2Body: Rank prompts by impact, tackling the top two before meetings.
slots.insight3Body: Log insights in a shared Notion page for later synthesis.
slots.pullQuote: The first 15 minutes set the day's research tempo.

slots.title: Batch and refine
slots.subtitle: On Friday, run a bulk prompt to summarize the week and adjust the roadmap.
slots.insight1Body: Prompt: ‘Summarize key findings from all notes this week.’
slots.insight2Body: AI highlights missing citations or unanswered questions.
slots.insight3Body: Translate insights into next‑week objectives with a one‑line action plan.
slots.pullQuote: Batching turns daily crumbs into a feast of insight.

slots.title: Measure the impact
slots.subtitle: Track time, output quality, and idea velocity to quantify the 10‑hour gain.
slots.insight1Body: Log hours before and after; see a 10‑hour weekly reduction.
slots.insight2Body: Citation accuracy rose 27% thanks to automated extraction.
slots.insight3Body: New paper outlines increased from 1 to 3 per week.
slots.pullQuote: Data proves the workflow isn’t a gimmick—it’s a multiplier.

slots.ctaBody: Download the full prompt library and tool checklist to plug into your own workflow and keep the momentum. Bookmark this carousel and revisit whenever you need a productivity boost.
